messages.subject: Infrastructure & Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. O'Donnell,

ODM Partners' executive-search focus across infrastructure and renewable-energy investors makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to utility-scale solar, battery storage and climate-resilience investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where infrastructure investment, energy transition, regulatory engagement and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
